response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The set of observatories is the set of stations that appear in telescopes, so stations with zero telescopes are excluded and the average share is 1 divided by the number of stations that have telescopes.
Ties at 10th place are broken arbitrarily, as the request allows.

alternatives.interpretation: All stations in the observatories table count as observatories, including those with zero telescopes. They then enter the average share with a share of 0, which lowers the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
